Title:ESTATE DUTY (AMENDMENT) BILL
MPs Speaking:Mr Lim Kim San (Minister for Finance); Mr A. P. Rajah (Mr Speaker);


Column: 39

ESTATE DUTY (AMENDMENT)
BILL
First Reading


    Mr Lim Kim San: Mr Speaker, Sir, I have His Excellency the Yang di-Pertuan Negara's recommendation to introduce a Bill intituled "An Act to amend the Estate Duty Ordinance

Column: 40

(Chapter 162 of the Revised Edition) and to repeal the Estate Duties (Apportionment and Miscellaneous Provisions) Ordinance (Chapter 283 of the Revised Edition) and the Estate Duty (Increase of Rates) Ordinance, 1955 (No. 39 of 1955)."

    Bill read the First Time.
Second Reading


    Mr Speaker: Second Reading, what day?

    Mr Lim Kim San: The first available sitting day in January, 1966.
